pages.text: When you know that there is a parasite in your head
So you search it
Every open space
Every hidden corner
And after finding nothing, you know that there is the only way
To burn it all to the ground.
And in the burned and barren land there is only one thing left
The Pit
The Pit will strip you of everything that is not You
You enter the pit to get rid of It.
And when you finally emerge after long and confusing time
You are just the same as before
But before entering uncertainty of the Planes of Nothingness
You consider everything only to avoid it
Even the possibility that the parasite
Is you
In The Planes of Nothingness
There is this strange peace
And despite there is nothing to look at or sense in any other way...
You still feel the time passing by.
Flow of the time...
...and light.
And you begin to realize that the only thing necessary to feel the flow of the time is the light.
Your light.
And the realization of the source of this strange peace is even more surprising
As there is nothing to look at, to sense, to keep...
...there is nothing to control, either. Only light and presence to sense.
These are The Planes of Nothingness after all.
And as you enjoy peace, light and time...
...you start to feel the disturbance.
It is the people trying to save you...
...from Nothing.

episodes.title: I have build this so that you can come in

pages.text: A dirt road lined with trees under a pale blue sky, the sun low on the left.
A blond person in a blue hoodie, holding a walking stick, steps between tree trunks at the edge of the road.
Looking down the tree-lined road toward a red sunset. A dark figure stands in the middle of the road.
A person in a blue hoodie with a backpack and rolled-up brown trousers stands on the road, trees and a red glow behind.
Under a pink sky, the two walkers stand at opposite ends of a row of trees, facing each other.
Close-up of two pairs of shoes facing each other on the path: dark high-tops on the left, worn trainers on the right.

episodes.title: Do not get used to this

pages.text: A row of four trees on a grassy plain under a deep violet night sky.
A person in a blue hood looks down. "Where am I?" "In the middle of Nothing." "There was a Pit..." "The Pit. I know. I have built this so that you can rest."

A simple world seen from above: a road between rows of bushes, a small fire glowing in the corner. "What is it that you have built, exactly?" "For now, only this road, some trees and surrounding fields. The simplest world."

The two travellers sit on either side of a campfire under the trees at night. "And this fire that cannot burn me but will keep us warm." "Yes." "In that case, can I make a wish?" "Yes." "May I have eyes, please?"
A close-up of a pair of brown eyes, a small flame reflected in each. "Yes, you may. But I am not going to draw them for every scene."

episodes.title: We have the trees at home

pages.text: A forest of huge orange-brown tree trunks in daylight. "May we have more trees?"
The same forest glowing red, with pink light between the trunks. "We may."
The same forest at night, grey trunks and fireflies in blue-green grass. "For how long?"
The same forest at dawn, warm trunks under a violet sky. "Until the stars fade away."
Title page in black ink: "Potoo vs Andal", in big hand-drawn letters over scribbled bushes and grass.
Endless rows of sharp, cross-hatched mountain peaks under an empty sky.
A shaggy horse with a long dark mane looks out over the mountains.
The shaggy horse stands on a rocky ledge, looking over the sea of mountains.
The shaggy horse gallops through the valley, mane and tail flying, past bushes and boulders.
Another horse, with a neatly braided mane, looks over a wooden fence in front of a hedge.
The braided horse leans over the fence, while the shaggy horse appears on the other side of the hedge.
The braided horse stares wide-eyed as the shaggy horse sticks its tongue out at it over the fence.
The shaggy horse gallops away happily into the mountains, through the bushes.
The empty mountain landscape, with a few rocks and a path leading into the hills.
Underwater, in violet light: a manatee swims past seagrass, while a snail-like creature peeks out from its shell beside a pink sea anemone. "That is beautiful." "Leave, please."
A smiling brown dinosaur stands by a lake under a purple evening sky with one bright star. "Why? You said 'Until the stars fade away'..." "They will - in a few minutes."
A burning orange star streaks across the purple sky over grass and stones by a stream. "You would destroy the world just to get rid of me?" "Of course. They are my words."
A swirl of violet, pink and blue specks, like a nebula. "I can build how many I want."

episodes.title: Creation and creativity come from the same source.

pages.text: Two sets of pink, ring-like shapes interlock at the centre like clasped hands, on a mossy green background. "Connection to the point of creation"
Waves of pink and bright green brushstrokes sweep across the picture. "The erotic pull"
Two arrows, one with a green tip and one with a pink tip, meet point to point in a burst of light against a blue sky. "The touch of two arrows that were pointing at each other."
A small green sprout with a pink bud rises from brown earth above a layer of turquoise water. "The seed reaching the hidden water source and growing again."
A white sphere at the centre of many coloured balls on sticks, like a molecule model, against a deep blue background. "We can hold multitudes."
A thorny green growth wraps around a pink stick and spreads over it. "Sometimes, parts get infected and try to leech on others."
The infected pink stick snaps in two, the green growth left holding the broken end. "So we have to let that part go."
Green tendrils coil tightly around the pink stick, holding on. "But some parasites are difficult to get rid of."
The molecule again, with one ball turned into a spiky green growth. "So in order to stop it from infecting the whole..."
A grey chunk is torn out of a larger sphere, still tangled in the green and pink growth. "We rip the part that belongs to the core."
The torn place on the grey sphere is covered by a glowing turquoise net. "But that is only an illusion."
A glowing sphere filled with swirls of blue, pink, green and orange. "Because at our core no division ever existed."
A pink anatomical heart inside a pale circle, a glowing pink wave winding around it. "All hearts have their specific tunes."
Two hearts side by side, their two waves rising and falling together. "Some hearts are naturally in tune with one another and they create a pleasant harmony."
Two hearts side by side, their waves clashing out of step, with jagged green sparks between them. "Some, on the other hand, create cacophony and unwanted tension, so they reject each other."
Four hearts, each with a wave of its own colour and rhythm: pink, red, blue and yellow. "It does not mean they are toxic. We are just different. All of us."
One heart wrapped in a tangle of many faint, colourful waves and one sharp, jagged black one. "Some hearts are a bit more complicated. They are hard to be in tune with, so they get rejected often."

The complicated heart in the middle, faint colours inside it, sends out only a simple, even wave toward four other hearts. "So in time they learn how to conceal their sound and let out only a simple tune. They sacrifice authenticity for (perceived) acceptance..."
On a green background, a woman with long hair looks on, wide-eyed. "Prečo si si oholila polku hlavy?" (Why did you shave half of your head?)

The same woman, now with one side of her head shaved, answers calmly. "Nie polku, ale tretinu. A na to, aby som mohla robiť komixy, kde sa rozprávam sama so sebou." (Not half, a third. And so that I can make comics where I talk to myself.)
The long-haired woman smiles slyly. "OK, OK... Ale ja budem tá rozumná a Ty tá prdlá. Inak do toho nejdem." (OK, OK... But I'll be the sensible one and You the crazy one. Otherwise I'm not doing it.)
The woman with the shaved side frowns, determined. "Platí." (Deal.)

On a blue background, a reporter with long hair holds out a microphone, mouth open in shock. "ŠKANDÁL! Tatérka sa nechala tetovať v strede leta! Čo nám k tomu poviete???" (SCANDAL! A tattoo artist got tattooed in the middle of summer! What do you have to say about it???)

The tattoo artist, with one side of her head shaved, answers the microphone with a frown. "Nevidím žiadny problém! Na dovolenke som už bola a do vody aj tak nechodím!" (I don't see any problem! I've already been on holiday and I don't go into the water anyway!)

The reporter, wide-eyed, presses on, with a little sun drawn beside the words. "Takže sa nebojíte slnka, potu a nimi spôsobeného zlého hojenia?" (So you're not afraid of the sun, sweat and the bad healing they cause?)

The tattoo artist answers calmly. "Vôbec. Strach je spôsobený nevedomosťou. Celé leto nosím dlhé voľné oblečenie a som úplne v pohode!" (Not at all. Fear comes from not knowing. All summer I wear long, loose clothes and I'm completely fine!)

Two snakes, one violet and one green, coil around each other in a spiral against a starry purple sky. Their heads meet at the top in the shape of a heart, tongues twining together, and glowing lights of yellow, pink and red shine inside the loops of their bodies.

A sketchbook page covered in looping violet ballpoint lines that curve out from the middle and back again, like two great wings or the field lines of a magnet. Across the centre: "Bol tam niekto z Vás?" (Has any of you been there?) Signed "27. 8. 2025, VeVe".
